name: Jackdaw
description: Inhabits data storage augments and collects one specific type of information obsessively — street names, temperatures, faces, prices. Different Jackdaws collect different things. None explain why.
observed_behavior: Fills available storage with repetitive cataloguing of a single data category. One Jackdaw collected 14 million temperature readings over two years.
story_hooks: A Jackdaw's collection of transit schedules reveals that specific routes have been subtly altered to funnel people away from a location nobody talks about
